subject: Project update and schedule
text: Hello, thank you for replying to my note; your earlier message gave me a useful reference point. The project update is favorable, though the schedule remains tight. We finished the initial review, confirmed the budget figures, and received approval for the revised milestone dates. The support team also completed its checklist, which removes the dependency that concerned us last week. During the next step, we will collect feedback from operations and prepare a short presentation for stakeholders. I will share those notes as soon as they arrive. One small issue remains with the file naming convention, but it should not delay the client-facing phase if it is corrected by Tuesday. If you have a few minutes, please let me know whether you would prefer to join the next internal call or simply receive a concise summary afterward. I appreciate your guidance and am grateful you checked in. The overall direction feels clearer than it did in the previous sprint. Best wishes,
